title: Disease-associated variants are enriched for altering cell-type-specific gene co-expression relationships
authors: Kaptijn D; Losert C; Korshevniuk M; Oelen R; Vochteloo M; Deelen P; Warmerdam R; Kooijmans A; Considine D; Tsepilov Y; Trynka G; Westra H; van der Wijst M; Bonder MJ; Heinig M; Franke L
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞RNA-seq进行共表达QTL定位，推断上游转录因子并预测基序破坏，但核心是基因共表达网络而非直接蛋白-DNA互作建模，且方法为统计遗传学而非AI或物理模拟。
abstract: Genes act within complex regulatory networks, and genetic variants can perturb these networks by altering gene co-expression. Here, we performed co-expression quantitative trait locus (co-eQTL) mapping using single-cell RNA-seq from the sc-eQTLGen consortium (1,330 donors, >2 million cells), enabling sensitive detection and prioritization of informative variant–gene–gene triplets. We identified co-eQTLs for 398 eGenes where a nearby genetic variant affected both the gene’s expression ( cis -gene) and its co-expression with other genes, often implicating upstream regulators. For 181 genes, we inferred a likely upstream transcription factor, with motif disruption predicted for 41 genes. These upstream genes are more often loss-of-function intolerant and show more network connections, providing an explanation for why co-eQTL variants are 2.8x more strongly associated with immune diseases than classical eQTLs. These findings position co-eQTLs as mechanistic links between genetic variation and disease, revealing how variants can rewire cell-type-specific gene networks.
abstract_zh: 基因在复杂的调控网络中发挥作用，遗传变异可通过改变基因共表达来扰动这些网络。在此，我们利用sc-eQTLGen联盟（1,330名供体，>200万个细胞）的单细胞RNA-seq进行了共表达数量性状位点（co-eQTL）定位，从而能够灵敏地检测和优先排序信息丰富的变异-基因-基因三元组。我们识别了398个eGenes的co-eQTL，其中邻近的遗传变异同时影响该基因的表达（顺式基因）及其与其他基因的共表达，通常涉及上游调控因子。对于181个基因，我们推断出可能的上游转录因子，并预测其中41个基因存在基序破坏。这些上游基因更常表现出对功能丧失的不耐受，并具有更多的网络连接，这解释了为何co-eQTL变异与免疫疾病的关联强度是经典eQTL的2.8倍。这些发现将co-eQTL定位为遗传变异与疾病之间的机制性联系，揭示了变异如何重塑细胞类型特异性基因网络。
